axis: K / IT9 P6 case: the HIF axis in the glycolytic shift (Q2)

mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: A mechanism experiment about whether the HIF-dependent part of the glycolytic shift is adaptive or harmful: partial benefit at best, and only if the shift is harmful. Not deep recovery. Track B: none.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

candidate.name: HIF axis lowering (genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown; PX-478-class lever) in the glycolytic shift, with a prolyl-hydroxylase 'mimic' as the direction control: a mechanism experiment, not a treatment

context.cell_type: embryonic fibroblast; MCF7; brown fat; muscle

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: HIF-1alpha protein is readily detected in the NUCLEI of knockout MEFs in normoxia and barely in wild type (qualitative nuclear-fraction detection), with less hydroxylation; HIF targets are higher; HIF1A knockdown rescues glucose uptake in the knockout MEFs; the difference disappears under hypoxia. HIF1A mRNA is comparable in skeletal muscle of knockout and wild-type mice (the paper's statement is for muscle, not MEFs). In knockout mice digoxin RAISES blood glucose (reversing their low glucose) and lowers GLUT1 and PHD3 expression. No neural cell type was examined.

disease_assertions.endpoint: ratio of normalised counts, knockout over wild type

context.disease_id: WWOX-deficient human cerebral organoid model (engineered knockout; NOT a patient allele)
context.genotype: WWOX knockout versus wild type (4 versus 2 libraries, one laboratory)

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: EPAS1 3.80 times, HK2 4.73 times, SLC2A1 2.67 times, ARNT 1.46 times; HIF1A mRNA 0.84 times (flat, as expected for a protein-level axis); PDK1 0.78 times. Four versus two libraries, one laboratory; the glycolytic genes also fall with elapsed culture time in unperturbed spheroids, so composition or maturity can contribute. IT10 P2.1 (premises a2, a3): the elevation is selective, a partly canonical hypoxia-response pattern and not a uniform glycolytic upshift (ADM, HK2, P4HA1, SLC2A1, BHLHE40, ANKRD37, EGLN3, DDIT4 up; PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PKM, PFKP, NDRG1, CA9 flat), compatible with HIF activity, with oxygen limitation of the organoid and with MYC (MYC +0.56 log2); the knockout's offsets in 12 progenitor and neuronal marker genes predict only a small maturity-related shift (median +0.08 to +0.16 log2 for HK2, SLC2A1, LDHA) against the observed +2.18, +1.40 and +0.75, which makes marker-measured maturity a minor contributor but does not exclude composition by unmeasured subpopulations or culture state (exploratory, calibration from another laboratory). HK2, SLC2A1 and PDK1 belong to the six-gene IT7 readout (guard IT7_READOUT6): they are observations here and cannot be used to evaluate any compound.

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: Restated 2026-10-31 (IT10 P2.1 and an independent verification of the source; Results 2.2 to 2.6 and Methods 4.2 read, figures not viewed). HRE-luciferase activity is HIGHER in the WWOX-depleted pool in 3 of 4 conditions; HIF1A mRNA is 1.5 to 1.9-fold higher (significant in 2 of 4); total HIF-1alpha by immunocytochemistry is higher in 2 conditions (the normoxia ones); lactate is higher in all four. The cytoplasmic and nuclear blots are separate assertions (DA-K01-005, DA-K01-006) and do not agree with these readouts on compartment. The earlier card text reported only the cytoplasmic decrease. Two laboratories (this one and the MEF paper) and no neural cell are not five confirmations. HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein have not been measured in any WWOX-deficient MAMMALIAN neural cell (one fly neuronal readout exists, DA-K01-008).

context.genotype: Wwox deletion versus control, 2 to 3 knockout versus 2 to 4 control animals

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: A COUNTER-OBSERVATION to the organoid rows: no elevation of HIF-axis or glycolysis transcripts in any of four contrasts; Hif1a within +-0.2 log2, Hk2 flat (-0.01 to +0.35), Epas1 lower (-0.21 to -0.58, animal-separated in 3 of 4), Slc2a1, Ldha and Pgk1 lower, Ndrg1 and P4ha1 lower in all four, Gfap higher. Caveats: bulk tissue and TPM; the animals come from lines with severe epilepsy and death at 3 to 4 weeks; background differences between control groups; no protein; gliosis and hypomyelination change composition. It does not side with the organoid: a species or in-vivo-versus-organoid disagreement is the largest unresolved fact of this axis. Exploratory, post hoc (IT10 P2.1 disclosure).

disease_assertions.target_id: sima:GFP (the single Drosophila HIF-alpha) fluorescence, adult fly brain
disease_assertions.endpoint: whole-brain ROI fluorescence of a sima:GFP reporter after neuronal Wwox knockdown, amyloid-beta 42 background
disease_assertions.source: PMID 42909904 (Lucas-Clarke 2026), Results (Figure 5F and G), Methods (imaging of the sima:GFP reporter) and supplementary stock table

context.disease_id: Drosophila neuronal Wwox knockdown in an amyloid-beta 42 background (not a DEE model)
context.genotype: pan-neuronal Wwox RNAi versus control, with human amyloid-beta 42 transgene

disease_assertions.measured_result_note: No change (t = 0.6623, P = 0.5185, N = 7 to 9 brains; amyloid background, one genotype pair, normoxia, not measured without the transgene or under hypoxia). The reporter's identity is internally inconsistent in the paper: the Results (and legend) say 'endogenously tagged sima:GFP', the Methods name 'the genetically encoded reporter line UAS-sima:GFP' (a driver-expressed transgene, whose level reports protein stability and not transcription), and the stock table lists a GFP-tagged sima PBac line (BDSC 42672). Sima is the single fly HIF-alpha, so no HIF-1 versus HIF-2 split is possible. The authors attribute the lactate rise to Atf4, not to sima. The only neural HIF-alpha protein readout in a WWOX-loss model, invertebrate, and not evidence of absence in mammals.

drug_assertions.target_id: HIF stabilisation by prolyl-hydroxylase inhibition (direction control)
drug_assertions.endpoint: EGLN1 inhibition; seizure and secondary-hypothyroidism label statements; thyroid-receptor action reported in a 2025 paper
drug_assertions.source: compound-database values for roxadustat (EGLN1 IC50 in the nanomolar to micromolar range; thyroid-receptor EC50 in the low nanomolar range), EU product information (seizures common); NOT WWOX EVIDENCE
drug_assertions.measured_result_note: A prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor RAISES HIF; whether that is the disease direction is NOT established (direction conditional, H-protect; IT10 P2.1 withdrew 'disease direction by construction'), so a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor is a conditional arm and not a 'mimic'; roxadustat is not a lever: its own label lists seizures (and secondary hypothyroidism), and a 2025 paper (Morita 2025, passages read) reports thyromimetic action, which is not a label statement; together with brain necrosis in rats this excludes roxadustat itself as a control in a seizure disorder (the reasons are label and pharmacology reasons, not direction). Compound-specific HIF-independent actions of prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitors (PMID 42150425) mean that no evidence is transferred between members and that any such arm needs HIF-null and prolyl-hydroxylase-null controls. A prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor without thyromimetic action (molidustat, from that single report) is named in the experiment and is TO BE VERIFIED.

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Loss of neuronal HIF-1alpha or HIF-2alpha worsens neonatal hypoxic-ischaemic injury and removes the benefit of preconditioning and cooling (abstract level; the three HIF-1alpha reports come from one research group); in the adult one full-text report agrees (larger infarct) and one goes the other way (brain-wide deletion protective). Lean: protective in neonatal acute injury; adult sign conflicts. A conditional pointer for the direction question (H-protect versus H-harm), acute injury and not a chronic genetic encephalopathy: no valence is assigned to the HIF change in a WWOX-deficient developing neuron.

drug_assertions.measured_result_note: Two-sided: a HIF agonist (DMOG) delayed epileptogenesis in the chronic phase and an inhibitor did the opposite, with no acute effect; HIF-1alpha overexpression raised CaV3.2 promoter activity and network firing; lowering HIF-1alpha, HDAC5 and PFKFB3 together accompanied fewer seizures; chronic neuronal activity itself raises LDHA through AMPK and HIF-1alpha. A glycolytic shift in a hyperactive network need not be WWOX-dependent. Abstract level for most rows; both agonist and inhibitor are non-selective.

p4_fields.endpoint_pursued: In WWOX-deficient versus corrected (isogenic add-back) human neural cells, at 5 percent oxygen (physioxia) as the primary condition beside 21 and 1 percent: HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein, nuclear and cytoplasmic, then whether lowering the axis (genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown, singly and together; a PX-478-class lever as a second arm) lowers lactate or extracellular acidification, glucose uptake and the five other members of the guard-scope 10-gene glycolysis set reported individually (a change there confirms the seed, it does not validate a lever), and what that does to network activity (multielectrode array), viability and SOX2/NEUN fractions. The direction of the HIF change is not established (two-sided literature, all non-WWOX): raising HIF is a conditional arm (H-protect), lowering it a conditional arm (H-harm), and three rivals that need no HIF role (culture state or composition, neuronal activity, MYC) have their own arms. The deciding readout is lactate or extracellular acidification and glucose uptake plus the five genes PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP and PKM reported individually; the six IT7 readout genes and the 10-gene glycolysis set they belong to are guard-scope members and cannot decide.
p4_fields.functional_evidence_available: None in a WWOX-deficient MAMMALIAN neural cell at the protein level; one fly neuronal readout exists (sima:GFP unchanged, amyloid background, reporter identity inconsistent). Non-neural: HIF-1alpha protein up in Wwox-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts (normoxia) with rescue by HIF1A knockdown; in a polyclonal human fibroblast pool HRE-luciferase is higher in 3 of 4 conditions, HIF1A mRNA 1.5 to 1.9-fold higher, total HIF-1alpha higher in 2 and lactate higher in all 4, while the cytoplasmic blot is lower in 2 of 4 and the nuclear blot shows no difference (different compartments). Human KO organoid: EPAS1 3.80 times, HK2 4.73 times, SLC2A1 2.67 times, HIF1A mRNA flat (transcripts, 4 versus 2 libraries), a selective hypoxia-response pattern. Counter-observation: mouse P17 brain shows no elevation of HIF-axis transcripts. Unresolved in vivo: hallmark hypoxia, apoptosis and glycolysis gene-set enrichment in the P47T knock-in brain (direction not stated in the text).
p4_fields.temporal_or_model_limit: WWOX-HIF-1alpha protein data are from non-neural cells; organoid data are transcripts of one deposit; the compound statements are cancer-model abstracts; human cells at the week of the phenotype are prenatal-equivalent.

p4_card.identity: A mechanism, not one compound: the HIF axis (HIF-1alpha, HIF-2alpha/EPAS1, ARNT). Genetic knockdown is the primary arm; PX-478 (ChEMBL CHEMBL4117516, free base; salt record CHEMBL4061538; verified by structure; a nitrogen-mustard alert) is one PX-478-class pharmacological arm; a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor is a conditional arm, direction conditional (H-protect) and not established as the disease direction, run only beside HIF-null and prolyl-hydroxylase-null controls (roxadustat is excluded on label and pharmacology grounds: seizures common and secondary hypothyroidism on its label, thyromimetic action in a 2025 paper).
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: WWOX-DEE only IF a HIF-dependent part of the glycolytic shift exists in WWOX-deficient neural cells and is harmful. The direction of the shift is uncertain, so both outcomes are conditional hypotheses; nothing here is a treatment proposal.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: NOT NEW as a pathway (DL-MECH-020 HIF1A to PDK to PDH; digoxin judged the wrong clinical object, N-07). NEW as a generated proposal (IT9 P2 Q2 'opposes' arm, qualified in IT9 P4c-e as KEEP-AS-PROPOSAL, a mechanism experiment).
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: DL-MECH-020, N-07, N-08, HYP-20260709-05 (PDK/DCA, card E03 and I01), card E02 (LDH).
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN. The experiment decides whether the HIF-dependent shift is adaptive (then lowering it should worsen viability or differentiation) or harmful (then lowering it should improve them).
p4_card.mechanism: Targets: HIF1A (HGNC:4910), EPAS1 (HGNC:3374), ARNT (HGNC:700); direction wanted: lower the axis, only IF the shift is harmful; the HIF target genes SLC2A1, HK2, LDHA, LDHB, BNIP3 and PDK1 are the IT7 readout and may not be used to evaluate any compound (guard IT7_READOUT6).

for: Wwox-null cells show higher HIF-1alpha protein and HIF targets, rescued by HIF1A knockdown (non-neural, normoxia).
The human knockout organoid shows EPAS1 3.80 times, HK2 4.73 times and SLC2A1 2.67 times (transcripts).
against: HIF1A mRNA is flat in the organoid and HIF-1alpha protein is not measured in any WWOX-deficient mammalian neural cell (one fly reporter is unchanged).

A human fibroblast pool shows LOWER cytoplasmic HIF-1alpha in two of four conditions and no nuclear difference on its own blot, one blot repetition shown (a different compartment from the nuclear increase in mouse cells), although its reporter, mRNA, total protein and lactate readouts go up; the authors' claim of nuclear translocation is not supported by their own blot.
Mouse P17 brain shows no elevation of HIF-axis transcripts (four contrasts; bulk, transcript, epileptic lines): the in-vivo brain does not side with the organoid.

The direction of a HIF change is open and two-sided: loss of neuronal HIF-alpha worsens neonatal hypoxic-ischaemic injury in mice, so lowering the axis may be harmful; rival explanations that need no HIF role are culture state or composition, neuronal activity and MYC.
The engine edge HIF1A to BNIP3 is review-sourced; the primary record is in non-neural lines.

PX-478 has no activity annotation in the compound database, a nitrogen-mustard alert, only adult phase 1 data and no CNS datum; the HIF axis supports neuronal energy and survival programmes, so lowering it may be harmful.
The organoid glycolytic genes also fall with culture time, so maturity or composition can explain part of the shift (exploratory).
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: No datum from a WWOX-deficient neural cell at the HIF protein or flux level; non-neural cells and cancer models only.

p4_card.pharmacology: PX-478: no activity or mechanism annotation in the compound database; action reported in cancer models; mustard alert; adult intravenous phase 1 only. Roxadustat: HIF-prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor; label: seizures and secondary hypothyroidism; thyromimetic action from a 2025 paper (excluded as a lever on label and pharmacology grounds). Belzutifan (HIF-2alpha inhibitor) stays INCONCLUSIVE: HIF-2alpha protein in WWOX-deficient neural cells is unmeasured.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

p4_card.predictions: None; no engine, no score. The experiment is proposed, not performed.
p4_card.next_measurement: Discriminating experiment with conditional arms (case record section 7, as extended by IT10 P2.1 and IT10 P5). Step 0: in WWOX-deficient versus corrected (isogenic add-back, two independent knockout clones or lines) human neural cells measure HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein, with hydroxylation or a HIF reporter if available, nuclear and cytoplasmic fractions separately, at 5 percent oxygen (physioxia, primary) and at 21 and 1 percent; 2D or progenitor cultures are primary. Organoids at week 8 to 15 have hypoxic cores and an organoid arm therefore requires a hypoxia marker (pimonidazole-type) and size matching in both genotypes, with stressed-cell filtering of any single-cell data. Rival-explanation arms: an activity-silenced arm (tetrodotoxin-type silencing in both genotypes, because chronic activity itself raises LDHA through AMPK and HIF-1alpha) and a MYC loss-of-function arm beside arm A (MYC is a primary-author rival for HK2 and SLC2A1). If a raised HIF protein is found: arm A genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown (singly and together) is primary; arm B a PX-478-class lever beside a non-mustard HIF-1alpha inhibitor, with arm A as the specificity reference; arm C starts GENETIC (VHL or EGLN1 loss) in both knockout and corrected cells, and a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor runs only beside HIF1A/EPAS1-null and prolyl-hydroxylase-null controls, compound by compound (compound-specific HIF-independent actions are documented; molidustat as a non-thyromimetic option is one report, TO BE VERIFIED; not roxadustat); the direction of that arm is conditional (H-protect), not the disease direction. Deciding readout: lactate or extracellular acidification and glucose uptake plus PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP and PKM reported individually (they belong to the guard-scope 10-gene set, so a change there confirms the seed and does not validate a lever); the six IT7 genes cannot decide. Network activity on a multielectrode array, viability and SOX2/NEUN fractions give the valence (adaptive versus harmful), relative to untreated knockout and to corrected cells, because HIF-1alpha can raise firing; a mixed outcome leaves the valence unresolved. Falsifier: neither HIF protein is higher in the WWOX-deficient neural cells (in the relevant compartment and oxygen condition), or knockdown does not move lactate or glucose uptake.
p4_card.value_added: Puts the HIF axis, the only Q2 item with direct non-neural WWOX support, on one card with its counter-evidence (cytoplasmic HIF-1alpha lower in a human fibroblast pool with no nuclear difference on its blot, flat organoid HIF1A mRNA, no elevation of HIF-axis transcripts in mouse P17 brain), the dropped and inconclusive neighbours and the guard that bars the six readout genes from evaluation.
p4_card.clinical_census: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-30 (IT9 P4c-e): PX-478 one study overall (phase 1, adult solid tumours and lymphoma); epilepsy, seizure, hypomyelination, neurodevelopment, WWOX and paediatric terms 0. A zero is no hits for the query string on that date, not proof that no study exists.
